page.content:
Captain Black was a Human male trooper who served in Republic Military during the Galactic War. He was killed by the Esh-kha on Belsavis whilst trying to retrieve a key to the Rakata vault.

page.overview:
Who is Black?

Captain Black was a Human male trooper who served in Republic Military during the Galactic War. He was killed by the Esh-kha on Belsavis whilst trying to retrieve a key to the Rakata vault.
